rules.expr: (sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", service_name!="flagd"}[2m])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name!="flagd"}[2m]))) > 0.05 and sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name!="flagd"}[2m])) > 0.05

annotations.description: Server spans of {{ $labels.service_name }} with status ERROR, over the last 2 minutes (span metrics of the demo's collector).
95th percentile duration of the server spans of {{ $labels.service_name }} over the last 5 minutes, above 1000 ms (span metrics of the demo's collector).
kube-state-metrics' restart count of container {{ $labels.container }} in pod {{ $labels.pod }} went up.
